plugins.name: Sombok-LED Glow Strip
plugins.author: Sombok 3D
plugins.description: Procedural LED glow strips, IES downlight washes, and pendant globe lights with soft quadratic falloff and live preview.
plugins.release_notes:
### What's New in v1.0.0:
- **LED Glow Strip Builder**: Curved and straight path extrusion with procedural falloff.
- **IES Wall Wash**: Directional wall washes with realistic photometric gradients.
- **Pendant Globe Lights**: Instant hanging ceiling lights with adjustable cords.
- **Interactive Auto-Weld Pick Tool**: Click-to-place with live viewport preview.
- Fully persistent configuration and color temperature presets.

plugins.name: Sombok IES Lighting Studio
plugins.author: Sombok 3D
plugins.description: Comprehensive library of 40+ IES photometric profiles with customizable beam angles, throw distance, and luminaire geometry.
plugins.release_notes:
### What's New in v1.2.0:
- Added 12 new architectural narrow-beam downlight profiles.
- Improved soft-shadow boundary computation.
- Batch placement across ceiling grids.
- Enhanced UI responsiveness.

plugins.name: Sombok Tile & Parquet Generator
plugins.author: Sombok 3D
plugins.description: Parametric floor & wall tile generator supporting herringbone, chevron, basketweave, brick bond, and hexagonal tessellations.
plugins.release_notes:
### What's New in v1.0.2:
- Chamfer edge beveling support.
- Automatic randomized tile orientation.
- High-performance polygon optimization for large floorplans.

plugins.name: Sombok PBR Material Studio
plugins.author: Sombok 3D
plugins.description: Curated library of over 150 high-resolution architectural PBR materials with seamless textures and automatic UV mapping.
plugins.release_notes:
### What's New in v1.1.0:
- 35 new luxury marble and quartzite slabs added.
- One-click seamless scaling and rotation adjustment.
- Optimized memory caching for smooth viewport navigation.
